title: Machine Manifest v1
description: Per-machine manifest schema per 04_architecture_proposal_v5.md §5.5.2. Covers all v5 fields. Phase 3 may extend for new fields discovered during 421-manifest authoring.

machine_id.description: Machine identifier, e.g. 'M274' or 'M273$WheelSelector$42$' for variants. Unique across the fleet.

manifest_version.description: Schema version number. Currently 1. Bump when the manifest schema breaks backward compatibility.

inherits_from.description: Filename of the parent manifest (e.g. 'M273.json') for variant machines. Null for non-variant (underlying) machines. Per §5.5.4-5.5.5.

console_diagnostic_complete.description: Non-variant machines only. True = operator declares console can diagnose correctly; hard errors on integrity failure. False = development mode; warnings only. Per §5.5.3.

console_diagnostic_complete_override.description: Variant manifests only. Must be false (never true — variants cannot elevate completeness above underlying). Per §5.5.7 rule 6 and rule 10. When set, override_set_at + override_set_reason + override_set_by are required.

override_set_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when console_diagnostic_complete_override: false was first applied. Required if console_diagnostic_complete_override: false is set. Per §5.5.7 v5 addition.

override_set_reason.description: Free-form text describing the specific edge case that triggered the override. Must reference the Layer(s) that fail on this variant's rawdata. Per §5.5.7 v5 addition.

override_set_by.description: Person/team/process responsible for the override decision (e.g. 'arch-team / 2026-05-17 arch review'). Per §5.5.7 v5 addition.

layer4_applicable.description: Whether rtp_integrity.py Step B (Layer 4 trigger-session re-attribution check) is applicable for this machine. False when trigger_session_pattern is non-null at machine level. Validated by rule 11: non-null trigger_session_pattern + layer4_applicable: true is an error. Per §5.5.2 v5 addition and §9.4.

paid.description: List of spin type integers that are paid rounds for this machine.

bonus.description: List of spin type integers that are bonus rounds for this machine. May be empty.

spin_type_convention.description: Spin type convention for this machine. Overridable per-mode via spin_type_convention_override. Per §5.5.6.

feature_tags.description: Human-readable tags describing this machine's feature cluster (e.g. ['BCM', 'Wheel']). Overridable per-mode. Per §5.5.2.

round_win_rules.description: List of round_win_rule IDs applicable to this machine. IDs must exist in machine_round_win_rules.json with this machine in applies_to. Per §5.5.2 and §5.9.

analyzer_features.description: FEATURE_ID strings declaring which AnalyzerFeature plugins apply to this machine. Must match feature_registry.ALL_FEATURES entries. Per §5.5.2 and §5.5.4.

bcm_target_feature.description: Name of the BCM target feature for BCM-class machines (e.g. 'ListRewardWheel', 'Wheel', 'MoveSpin'). Overridable per-mode via bcm_target_feature_override. Per §5.5.6.

selector_type.description: Selector class name for selector-type machines (e.g. 'TopDollarSelector'). Informational; used by variants fleet routing. Per §5.11 M15 example.

trigger_session_pattern.description: Trigger-session re-attribution pattern. Null = no trigger sessions (Layer 4 applicable). 'type_1' or 'type_2' = trigger sessions present (sets layer4_applicable: false per rule 11). Overridable per-mode via trigger_session_pattern_override. Per §5.5.6 and §9.4.

modes_supported.description: List of mode integers this machine supports (e.g. [1, 2, 5, 7]). Per §5.5.2.

per_mode_overrides.description: Per-mode override blocks keyed by string mode number ('1', '2', '5', '7', etc.). Each block applies resolution per §5.5.6: _remove then _add for list fields; _override for scalar fields. Fields machine_id, manifest_version, inherits_from, console_diagnostic_complete, layer4_applicable cannot be overridden here (§5.5.6 line 472).

rtp_integrity_contract.description: RTP integrity contract for this machine. Per §5.5.2.

per_mode_override_block.description: Override block for a single mode. Applies _remove then _add per §5.5.6 line 474.

analyzer_features_add.description: FEATURE_IDs to append to the base analyzer_features list for this mode.

analyzer_features_remove.description: FEATURE_IDs to remove from the base analyzer_features list for this mode.

round_win_rules_add.description: Rule IDs to append to round_win_rules for this mode.

round_win_rules_remove.description: Rule IDs to remove from round_win_rules for this mode.

trigger_session_pattern_override.description: Replacement trigger_session_pattern for this mode. Per §5.5.6 and P1.

feature_tags_override.description: Replacement feature_tags list for this mode (replaces entirely, not merged).

expected_paid_st.description: Expected paid spin type integers (must be non-empty per rule 7).

expected_bonus_st.description: Expected bonus spin type integers (may be empty list for machines with no bonus STs).

required_attribution_anchors.description: Pay-ID prefixes/strings required for RTP attribution coverage. Validated at first run against rawdata (not at commit time per rule 7). May be empty for plain machines.
